highlights.title: Close a task as replaced by another
highlights.line: A task that a later task replaced can be closed as replaced by it: its page links to the new task, and the Tasks list says so.

highlights.title: Close a task and its subtasks at once
highlights.line: When every subtask of a task is built, one press on that task's page closes each subtask and then the task itself.

highlights.title: See which agent changed a file
highlights.line: A project's Files page usually shows which Claude agent changed a file last.

highlights.title: A paused room says why
highlights.line: When Kosmos pauses a room whose agents kept going back and forth, a note above the message box says why and offers Reopen.

highlights.title: A project shows each member's role
highlights.line: A project's member list now shows the role each member set for that project.
